feedback: Revise before racing. The candidate changes only the outer sensors, from x = ±0.024 m to ±0.020 m, and keeps the iteration 5 controller. The stated mechanism, less signal saturation at the edges, is not supported by the evidence. The signal is the reading-weighted average of sensor_weights, and the weights are proportional to x. Pulling the outer sensors inward by about 17% therefore scales the steering signal by roughly 0.83 for the same line offset, which acts like a lower effective kp. The only clean gain sweep has kp 2.0 at 115.4 (iteration 2), kp 2.5 at 159.2 (iteration 3) and kp 3.0 at 83.5 (iteration 4). Lower effective gain is therefore likely to lose ground, not gain it. Iteration 9 confirmed that the iteration 5 design is repeatable at 160.41, so there is no need to re-race it. Every controller lever has been tested (kp, kd, ki, base_speed-adjacent evidence, line_loss direction), and the untested geometry lever with a different mechanism is the forward position of the sensors (y). Sensor y is fixed at 0.03 m in every iteration. Moving the sensors forward gives the steering a longer lead before the wheels reach the line, which is a different effect from scaling gain. Keep the x positions at iteration 5 values. Next race, depending on the telemetry: if max_error on the oval and s-bend stays at about 0.060 to 0.062 m with line_loss_events unchanged (1.3, 2.0), and steering_oscillation stays below 0.3, then the forward sensors are not the limit either and the best option is to race iteration 5 as the final design. If max_error rises or oscillation exceeds 0.3, revert y to 0.03 m. Do not test further gains.
requested_changes: Keep geometry.sensor_positions x at the iteration 5 values (±0.024, ±0.012, 0.0) because narrowing the span scales the steering signal down like a lower kp. Move all five sensors forward from y = 0.03 to y = 0.05 m as the only change, to test a different mechanism (earlier steering lead) that has not been tried.

If max_error exceeds the iteration 5 values (0.0604 oval, 0.0623 s-bend, 0.0616 slalom) or steering_oscillation exceeds 0.3 on any track with the forward sensors: revert y to 0.03 m and approve the iteration 5 design unchanged.

Keep every controller field at iteration 5 values (base_speed 1.3, kp 2.5, ki 0.05, kd 0.3, weights [2,1,0,-1,-2], line_loss search_right), because the gain and line-loss sweeps in iterations 4 to 8 showed no improvement.
